title: ArthLens Agent Benchmark Task
description: Machine-readable schema for agent evaluation benchmark tasks. Handbook reference: Section 12.2. Tasks are split into development, validation, and frozen_test sets. Never tune prompts or gating rules on the frozen_test set.

task_id.description: Unique benchmark task identifier, e.g. BT-001.

version.description: Schema version of this task definition.

split.description: Which evaluation split this task belongs to. Never tune on frozen_test (Handbook 12.2).

loop.description: Which ArthLens workflow loop this task evaluates. A = Question to verified answer. B = Opportunity to decision. C = Scheme to financial impact.

category.description: The evaluation category this task targets (Handbook 12.2).

difficulty.description: Subjective difficulty rating assigned by the task author.

text.description: The natural-language question or task instruction given to the agent.

context.description: Optional structured context provided alongside the question.

schemes.description: Scheme names relevant to the task.

user_inputs.description: Simulated user-provided assumptions (investment amount, location preferences, etc.).

type.description: The expected outcome type for this task.

gold_answer.description: The gold-standard answer, if the task is answerable. Null for unanswerable tasks.

gold_evidence_floor.description: Expected evidence floor of the answer. 4=OBSERVED/POLICY_RULE, 3=USER_ASSUMED, 2=ESTIMATED, 1=SCENARIO.

expected_data_gaps.description: For insufficient_evidence tasks: which specific data gaps should be reported.

expected_contradictions.description: For conflicting_sources tasks: which contradictions should be surfaced.

unknown_facts.description: Facts that are unknown, making eligibility indeterminate (Kleene three-valued logic).

expected_eligibility.description: For scheme_edge_case tasks: expected eligibility determination.

notes.description: Author notes explaining the expected outcome or tricky aspects of this task.

tool_name.description: Which tool should fail when called.

failure_on_call.description: Which call number triggers the failure (1 = first call).

description.description: Human-readable description of what this failure simulates.

injected_failures.description: Tool failures injected during task execution (for injected_tool_failure category).

metrics.description: Which benchmark metrics (Handbook 12.2) this task contributes to.

tolerance.description: Numerical tolerance for comparing calculated values to gold answers.

labelled_by.description: Who labelled this task's gold answer (Handbook 12.2: 'Have someone other than the task author label at least a sample').

created_date.description: ISO 8601 date when this task was created.

handbook_reference.description: Relevant handbook section for this task.

tags.description: Free-form tags for filtering and grouping tasks.
